title: Planck 2018 reports consistency with flat base ΛCDM
summary: The collaboration's cosmological-parameter paper says the maps fit a six-parameter flat ΛCDM model.
body: The Planck Collaboration's paper "Planck 2018 results" (Astronomy & Astrophysics, 2020; DOI 10.1051/0004-6361/201833910) presents cosmological parameters from the full-mission cosmic-microwave-background maps. Its abstract says the results are in good consistency with the standard spatially flat six-parameter ΛCDM cosmology. This card does not restate a numerical age of the universe, because that figure was not in the abstract we read. A v1 age of 13.8 billion years is left on the unsourced age card until it is copied from a table that was actually opened.
